DISPOSITION: conditional yes. The 1,000 microsegments, 50 coarse markers, row/time coordinates, character/location/speaker fields and presentation features support a human-derived temporal source atlas plus proposal evidence. They do not supply a ready NarrativeGraph, direct episode observation, typed relations, stable entities, dialogue propositions, or independent gold. The raw clock has a two-run reset, two scan-break rows and one zero-duration row. The 30-HMM path is a Diagnostic derivation and its carried parameters saw recall-scoring outcomes. Annotation-content licence remains Unknown: root MIT is not annotation-specific, Summer-MIND has no detected licence, and OpenNeuro CC0 does not transfer to a workbook absent from that dataset. Content stays external.

CHIEF GATE PASS:
- git diff HEAD^ HEAD --check: clean.
- 10/10 exact source links resolve HTTP 200.
- story-text admission: only locators, hashes, column names, aggregate facts and conclusions; no annotation-cell prose, participant language, episode dialogue or frames.
- pre-commit whole index exactly one staged path; commit used git commit --only.
- post-commit diff-tree exactly one added path; index empty. Full pathless status still exposes unrelated Mote/NFRD untracked work and none entered the commit.
- no code tests, per the chief-confirmed proportional docs gate.

Formal reviewer is codex-storyatlas-root because that actor owns the film Stage A seam; please review the scientific boundary and the locator/denominator/absence-erasure handoff. Chief remains authorizer and lands. Candidate currently also reports the already-known ancestor_abandoned a371e10 ledger fault; I did not alter history to hide it.
